protocol.status: exploratory; parameters written before first execution; historical data already exposed

families.breakout20: close exceeds all preceding 20 highs, EMA20 > EMA50, current volume >= 1.5 * preceding 20 mean volume
families.recovery30: rolling-arithmetic RSI14 crosses from <=30 to >30 and close exceeds preceding candle high

protocol.stop: minimum low of signal bar and preceding 9 bars minus 0.5 ATR14 Wilder
protocol.target: entry + 2 * (entry - stop); predeclared experimental target, not observed resistance
protocol.expiry: existing engine: exit at close of entry index +20; 21 bars inspected
protocol.folds: 3 successive equal windows after first 50% of sample; warmup from past; no parameter fitting; each fold starts USD1000; complete holding windows only; historical windows already exposed
protocol.costs: existing brut / central / prudent hypotheses; account fees unknown
protocol.benchmarks: cash; buy-hold full capital in each evaluation window under same costs, unequal risk exposure
protocol.statistics: realized-equity drawdown only; no annualized Sharpe from sparse trade returns; no statistical validation
